plan.title: Reject Auction End Price Above RFQ L1

steps.note: Open the prepared closed RFQ with bids from Vendor A and Vendor B.
Enable eRFX projects as required by the case configuration.
Open the RFQ-to-Auction conversion flow, continue through its conversion prompt, and land on the auction create screen.
Confirm the conversion opened the auction create screen.
Set an auction end price above the RFQ L1 sum total of 900.
Attempt to publish the converted auction with the invalid end price.
